exercises.explanationUz:
TO'RT MASHHUR SHAXS:
  Picasso, Louis Pasteur, Giuseppe Verdi, Federico Fellini

USUL: har birining MILLATI berilgan —
u ham yordam beradi.

KASB NOMLARI:
  a painter       = rassom
  a ballet dancer = balet raqqosi
  a composer      = bastakor
  a director      = rejissor; direktor
  an actor        = aktyor
  a scientist     = olim
  a film director = kinorejissor
  a singer        = qo'shiqchi

items.whyUz:
PABLO PIKASSO — ispan RASSOMI (1881-1973).
Kubizm yo'nalishining asoschisi.
'a painter' = rassom (bo'yoq bilan chizadi).
Coursebook 73-betdagi 14-mashqda rassomlar bor edi.

items.hintUz: Pasterizatsiya usuli kimning nomi bilan atalgan?
items.whyUz:
LUI PASTER — fransuz OLIMI (1822-1895).
Mikroblarni o'rgangan, emlash va pasterizatsiyani ixtiro qilgan.
'a scientist' = olim.
Mari Kyuri ham olima edi (Coursebook 70-bet).

JUZEPPE VERDI — italyan BASTAKORI (1813-1901).
Mashhur operalar yozgan: 'Aida', 'La Traviata', 'Rigoletto'.
'a composer' = bastakor.
Coursebook 73-betdagi 15-mashqda bastakorlar bor edi.

FEDERIKO FELLINI — italyan KINOREJISSORI (1920-1993).
'La Dolce Vita' va '8½' filmlari bilan mashhur.
'a film director' = kinorejissor.
DIQQAT: 'AN Italian' — 'I' unli tovush → AN.

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in the gaps with words from the list.
exercises.explanationUz:
RO'YXAT (8 ta so'z, 8 ta bo'shliq):
  received, popular, discovered, poor, favourite,
  became, married, talented

Har biri AYNAN BIR MARTA ishlatiladi.

IKKI GURUHGA BO'LINADI:

  FE'LLAR (o'tgan zamonda):
     received, discovered, became, married

  SIFATLAR:
     popular, poor, favourite, talented

USUL: bo'shliqdan keyin OT bo'lsa → SIFAT kerak,
keyin OT bo'lsa ham fe'l bo'lishi mumkin —
kontekstga qarang.

items.textEn: 1  George is a kind person. He always helps ............ people.
items.whyUz:
'POOR people' = kambag'al odamlar.
Mehribon odam muhtojlarga yordam beradi.
Coursebook 71-betda: 'sick and POOR people'.
'poor' aksi: rich.

'my FAVOURITE actor' = sevimli aktyorim.
Amerikacha yozilishi: favorite ('u' siz).
Richard Gir — amerikalik aktyor.

'MARRIED my mother' = onamga uylandi.
marry → married ('r' undosh + 'y' → -IED).
DIQQAT: 'married WITH' XATO — 'with' KERAK EMAS.

items.textEn: 4  Mother Teresa ............ the Nobel Prize for Peace in 1979.
items.whyUz:
'RECEIVED the Nobel Prize' = Nobel mukofotini oldi.
receive → received (oxiri 'e' → faqat + D).
Ona Tereza 1979-yilda tinchlik bo'yicha Nobel mukofotini olgan.
Coursebook 72-73-betlarda ham 'received the Nobel Prize' bor edi.

'a very TALENTED composer' = juda iqtidorli bastakor.
'talent' = iqtidor;  'talented' = iqtidorli.
Bethoven — nemis bastakori (1770-1827).
Coursebook 73-betda 'the talented young man' (Motsart) bor edi.

items.textEn: 6  The Beatles were very ............ in the 60s.
items.whyUz:
'very POPULAR' = juda mashhur, sevimli.
'The Beatles' — ingliz musiqiy guruhi (60-yillar).
DIQQAT: guruh nomi oldidan THE, fe'l KO'PLIKDA ('were').
'in the 60s' = 60-yillarda.

'DISCOVERED America' = Amerikani kashf etdi.
discover → discovered (to'g'ri fe'l).
Grammar 47-betdagi 19-mashqda ham shu gap bor edi.

items.textEn: 8  I met Jane at a party and we ............ friends.
items.whyUz:
'BECAME friends' = do'stlashdik.
become → BECAME (noto'g'ri fe'l).
Coursebook 74-betda ham: 'They became friends'.
meet → MET (noto'g'ri fe'l).

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in with: in, round, with, at, of, on, to.
exercises.instructionUz: in, round, with, at, of, on, to predloglarini qo'ying.
exercises.explanationUz:
RO'YXAT: in, round, with, at, of, on, to

7 ta predlog, 11 ta bo'shliq — demak ba'zilari
BIR NECHA MARTA ishlatiladi:
  in  → 4 marta
  on  → 2 marta
  qolganlari → 1 martadan

ASOSIY QOIDALAR:

  SANA va VAQT:
     ON + aniq sana      on 2nd August, 1991
     IN + oy yoki yil    in September, 1997

  JOY:
     IN + shahar         in Brighton
     AT + muassasa       at a boarding school
     ON + televizor      on TV

  O'LIM SABABI (eng muhim juftlik):
     die IN an accident  → HODISA
     die OF an illness   → KASALLIK

  BOShQA:
     travel ROUND the world  = dunyo bo'ylab
     return TO a place       = biror joyga qaytmoq
     problems WITH something = ...da muammo
     those IN need           = muhtojlar

items.whyUz:
'study AT a school' — maktab va universitet bilan AT.
'a boarding school' = internat maktab
(Coursebook 71-betda Diana o'qigan joy).

Aniq sana → ON.
'on 2nd August, 1991'.

Shahar → IN.
Braiton — Angliyaning janubidagi dengiz bo'yidagi shahar.

'people IN need' = muhtoj odamlar.
Coursebook 71-72-betlarda 'those IN need' bor edi.

items.textEn: 4  There was a good film ............ TV last night.
items.whyUz:
'ON TV' = televizorda.
Shunga o'xshash: on the radio, on the Internet.
Coursebook 71-betda 'watched her wedding ON television'.

items.textEn: 5  James Dean died ............ a car accident.
items.whyUz:
'die IN an accident' = halokatda halok bo'lmoq.
Jeyms Din — amerikalik aktyor, 1955-yilda
avtohalokatda 24 yoshida halok bo'lgan.
8-band bilan SOLISHTIRING.

items.textEn: 6  Carlo travelled ............ the world for a year ...  [1-bo'shliq]
items.whyUz:
'travel ROUND the world' = dunyo bo'ylab sayohat qilmoq.
'round' = 'around' bilan bir xil (britanchada 'round' ko'proq).
Coursebook 71-72-betlarda ham bor edi.

'return TO a place' = biror joyga qaytmoq.
Coursebook 71-betda: 'When she RETURNED TO England'.

items.textEn: 7  Mike and Sarah had problems ............ their marriage ...  [1-bo'shliq]
items.whyUz:
'have problems WITH something' = ...da muammo bo'lmoq.
Coursebook 71-betda: 'They had problems WITH their marriage'.

Kun ko'rsatilmagan, faqat oy va yil → IN.
2-band bilan solishtiring: u yerda kun bor edi → ON.

'die OF an illness' = kasallikdan vafot etmoq.
'pneumonia' = pnevmoniya, o'pka yallig'lanishi.
5-band bilan SOLISHTIRING — bu eng muhim juftlik:
  die IN an accident  (halokat)
  die OF an illness   (kasallik)
Coursebook 72-betda ham: 'died OF leukaemia'.

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in: became, was, won, died, taught, studied.
exercises.instructionUz: became, was, won, died, taught, studied so'zlarini qo'ying.
exercises.explanationUz:
TO'LIQ MATN (to'ldirilgan holda):

  Henry Moore WAS a famous British sculptor. He was born on
  30th July, 1898 in Yorkshire.

  Moore STUDIED art in Leeds and at the Royal College of
  Art in London. In 1926, he BECAME an art teacher and he
  TAUGHT at the Royal College of Art for six years. In 1948
  he WON the Venice Biennale sculpture prize.

  Henry Moore DIED on 31st August, 1986, in Hertfordshire.


O'ZBEKCHA TARJIMASI:
  Genri Mur mashhur britaniyalik haykaltarosh edi.
  U 1898-yil 30-iyulda Yorkshirda tug'ilgan.
  Mur Lidsda va Londondagi Qirollik san'at kollejida
  san'at o'qidi. 1926-yilda san'at o'qituvchisi bo'ldi va
  Qirollik san'at kollejida olti yil dars berdi.
  1948-yilda Venetsiya biennalesining haykaltaroshlik
  mukofotini yutdi.
  Genri Mur 1986-yil 31-avgustda Xertfordshirda vafot etdi.


OLTI FE'L, OLTI BO'SHLIQ — har biri BIR MARTA.

HAMMASI NOTO'G'RI FE'L, faqat 'studied' TO'G'RI:
  be    → WAS
  study → STUDIED   (TO'G'RI fe'l: -IED)
  become → BECAME
  teach → TAUGHT
  win   → WON
  die   → DIED      (TO'G'RI fe'l: + D)

USUL: har bir bo'shliqning atrofidagi so'zlarga qarang.
  ... art in Leeds     → o'qish → studied
  ... an art teacher   → bo'lish → became
  ... at the College   → dars berish → taught
  ... the prize        → yutish → won

YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  a sculptor  = haykaltarosh
  sculpture   = haykaltaroshlik
  art         = san'at
  a college   = kollej
  a prize     = mukofot
  a biennale  = biennale (ikki yilda bir o'tkaziladigan ko'rgazma)

GENRI MUR HAQIDA:
  Britaniyaning eng mashhur haykaltaroshi.
  Yirik bronza haykallari butun dunyo shaharlarida bor.

items.textEn: 1  Henry Moore ............ a famous British sculptor.
items.whyUz:
Kasb aytilyapti → 'to be' fe'li.
'Henry Moore' BIRLIK → WAS.
'a sculptor' = haykaltarosh.

items.textEn: 2  Moore ............ art in Leeds and at the Royal College of Art in London.
items.whyUz:
'STUDIED art' = san'at o'qidi.
study → STUDIED ('d' undosh + 'y' → -IED).
Ro'yxatdagi yagona TO'G'RI fe'l (die dan tashqari).

'BECAME an art teacher' = san'at o'qituvchisi bo'ldi.
become → BECAME (noto'g'ri fe'l).
'AN art teacher' — 'a' unli tovush → AN.

items.textEn: 4  ... and he ............ at the Royal College of Art for six years.
items.whyUz:
'TAUGHT at the College' = kollejda dars berdi.
teach → TAUGHT (noto'g'ri fe'l), o'qilishi /tɔːt/.
'teached' XATO.
'teach AT' — predlog AT.
'for six years' = olti yil davomida.

items.textEn: 5  In 1948 he ............ the Venice Biennale sculpture prize.
items.whyUz:
'WON the prize' = mukofotni yutdi.
win → WON (noto'g'ri fe'l), o'qilishi /wʌn/.
DIQQAT: 'one' /wʌn/ bilan bir xil o'qiladi.
'Venice' = Venetsiya.

items.textEn: 6  Henry Moore ............ on 31st August, 1986, in Hertfordshire.
items.whyUz:
die → died (to'g'ri fe'l, oxiri 'e' → faqat + D).
'ON 31st August' — aniq sana → ON.
'IN Hertfordshire' — joy → IN.

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in the past simple of the verbs.
exercises.instructionUz: Fe'llarning oddiy o'tgan zamon shaklini yozing.
exercises.explanationUz:
O'N OLTI FE'L — TO'G'RI va NOTO'G'RI ARALASH.

TO'G'RI FE'LLAR (7 ta):
  appear → appeared    (oddiy + ED)
  stop   → stopped     (undosh IKKILANADI)
  star   → starred     (undosh IKKILANADI)
  travel → travelled   (britancha: L ikkilanadi)
  finish → finished    (oddiy + ED)
  move   → moved       (oxiri -E → + D)
  produce → produced   (oxiri -E → + D)
  direct → directed    (oddiy + ED)

NOTO'G'RI FE'LLAR (8 ta):
  buy   → bought
  write → wrote
  sing  → sang
  come  → came
  win   → won
  sink  → sank
  eat   → ate
  lose  → lost

DIQQAT — UNDOSH IKKILANIShI:
  stop → stoPPed;  star → staRRed
  Sababi: bir bo'g'inli, oxiri UNDOSH+UNLI+UNDOSH,
  urg'u shu bo'g'inda → oxirgi undosh ikkilanadi.
  (Grammar 42-betdagi 3-qoida.)

DIQQAT — 'SING' va 'SINK' JUFTLIGI:
  sing → SANG  (qo'shiq aytmoq)
  sink → SANK  (cho'kmoq)
  Ikkalasi ham 'i' → 'a' ga aylanadi — bir xil naqsh.

items.whyUz:
appear → appeared.
'to appear' = paydo bo'lmoq (Coursebook 70-71-betlarda).

stop → stoPPed.
Bir bo'g'inli, oxiri UNDOSH+UNLI+UNDOSH (s-t-O-p),
urg'u shu bo'g'inda → 'p' IKKILANADI.
Grammar 42-betdagi 3-qoida.

buy → BOUGHT, o'qilishi /bɔːt/.
'y' bor, lekin -IED qoidasi ISHLAMAYDI.

write → WROTE.
Oxiri 'e' bo'lsa ham 'writed' XATO.

star → staRRed.
'to star' = bosh rolda o'ynamoq (film haqida).
's-t-A-r' — urg'uli unli ikki undosh orasida →
'r' IKKILANADI.
2-band bilan bir xil qoida.
Ot sifatida 'a star' = yulduz.

sing → SANG.
11-band bilan solishtiring: sink → SANK.
Ikkalasida ham 'i' → 'a'.

travel → TRAVELLED (britancha).
Amerikachada: traveled (bitta L).
DIQQAT: urg'u BIRINCHI bo'g'inda (TRA-vel) bo'lsa ham
britanchada 'L' doim ikkilanadi — bu ISTISNO.

come → CAME.
'become → became' bilan bir xil naqsh.

win → WON, o'qilishi /wʌn/.
DIQQAT: 'one' bilan bir xil o'qiladi.
4-mashqning 5-bandida ham bor edi.

finish → finished.
Oxiri 'sh' → -ed /t/ deb o'qiladi.

sink → SANK.
'to sink' = cho'kmoq.
6-band bilan bir xil naqsh (sing → sang).
6-mashqning 7-bandida Titanik haqida ishlatiladi.

move → moved.
'to move' = ko'chib o'tmoq (Grammar 44-betda ham).

eat → ATE, o'qilishi /eɪt/ ('eyt').
'eated' XATO.

produce → produced.
'to produce' = ishlab chiqarmoq; (film) prodyuserlik qilmoq.
'a producer' = prodyuser.

lose → LOST.
'to lose' = yo'qotmoq; yutqazmoq.
9-band bilan JUFT: win (yutmoq) ↔ lose (yutqazmoq).
Grammar 43-betda: 'he lost it all'.

direct → directed.
'to direct a film' = film rejissorligi qilmoq.
'a director' = rejissor (1-mashqning 4-bandi).
-ed /ɪd/ deb o'qiladi (oxiri 't').

exercises.instructionEn: First, put the verbs into the past simple.
exercises.instructionUz: Avval fe'llarni oddiy o'tgan zamonga qo'ying.
exercises.explanationUz:
ENG MUHIM QOIDA — BU MASHQDA 'DID' YO'Q!

  Savol so'zi ('Who', 'Which film', 'Which country',
  'Which ship') EGA vazifasini bajaryapti.

  EGA so'ralganda 'did' KERAK EMAS —
  fe'l TO'G'RIDAN-TO'G'RI o'tgan shaklda turadi:

     Who DIRECTED E.T.?        ✓
     Who DID direct E.T.?      (odatda ishlatilmaydi)

SOLISHTIRING — Grammar 44-betdagi 7-mashqning 5-bandi:
  'WHO did you visit last week?'
  U yerda 'who' TO'LDIRUVChI edi (kimni?) → 'did' KERAK.

  Bu yerda esa:
  'WHO directed E.T.?'
  'who' EGA (kim?) → 'did' KERAK EMAS.

FARQNI ANIQLASH USULI:
  Javob EGA bo'lsa → 'did' yo'q
     Who wrote it? — DICKENS wrote it.  (Dickens = ega)
  Javob TO'LDIRUVChI bo'lsa → 'did' bor
     Who did you visit? — I visited MY AUNT.

items.whyUz:
'Who DIRECTED ...?' — 'who' EGA → 'did' KERAK EMAS.
direct → directed (to'g'ri fe'l).
'E.T.' — 1982-yilgi mashhur film.

items.textEn: 2  Who ............ (become) President of the USA in 1992?
items.whyUz:
become → BECAME.
'President of the USA' — unvon oldidan artikl YO'Q
('become President' — turg'un ibora).

receive → received (oxiri 'e' → + D).
'Which film' EGA → 'did' KERAK EMAS.
'an Oscar' = Oskar mukofoti.

items.textEn: 4  Who ............ (sing) Candle in the Wind for Princess Diana?
items.whyUz:
sing → SANG.
'Candle in the Wind' — Diana dafn marosimida
aytilgan qo'shiq (1997).
Coursebook 71-betdagi Diana bilan bog'liq.

items.textEn: 5  Which country ............ (win) the World Cup in 1998?
items.whyUz:
win → WON.
'the World Cup' = Jahon chempionati (futbol).
5-mashqning 9-bandida ham bor edi.

write → WROTE.
'Oliver Twist' — Charlz Dikkensning romani.
Dikkens Grammar 43-betdagi 3-mashqda bor edi.

sink → SANK.
5-mashqning 11-bandida ham bor edi.
Titanik 1912-yil 15-aprelda cho'kkan.

exercises.instructionEn: Then match the questions to the answers.
exercises.explanationUz:
YETTI JAVOB:
  A  France
  B  The Titanic
  C  Elton John
  D  Steven Spielberg
  E  Ben Hur
  F  Charles Dickens
  G  Bill Clinton

Har bir javob — SAVOLNING EGASI.
Shuning uchun savolda 'did' yo'q edi.

pairs.whyUz:
Stiven Spilberg — amerikalik kinorejissor.
'E.T. The Extra-Terrestrial' (1982) — uning eng mashhur
filmlaridan biri.
'extra-terrestrial' = koinotdan kelgan mavjudot.

pairs.left: 2  Who became President of the USA in 1992?

pairs.whyUz:
'Ben Hur' (1959-yilgi film) 1960-yilgi marosimda
11 ta Oskar olgan — o'sha davr uchun rekord.

pairs.left: 4  Who sang Candle in the Wind for Princess Diana?
pairs.leftUz: Malika Diana uchun 'Candle in the Wind' ni kim kuyladi?
pairs.whyUz:
Elton Jon — ingliz qo'shiqchisi va pianinochisi.
1997-yilda Diananing dafn marosimida bu qo'shiqni aytgan.

pairs.left: 5  Which country won the World Cup in 1998?
pairs.whyUz:
1998-yilgi futbol bo'yicha jahon chempionati
Fransiyada bo'lgan va Fransiya g'olib chiqqan.

Charlz Dikkens — ingliz yozuvchisi (1812-1870).
Grammar 43-betdagi 3-mashqda uning tarjimai holi bor edi.

Titanik 1912-yil 15-aprelda aysbergga urilib cho'kkan.
'The Titanic' — kema nomi oldidan THE.

exercises.instructionEn: Now make sentences, as in the example.
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:
  Spielberg directed E.T. The Extra-Terrestrial.

QOLIP:
  [javob = EGA] + [o'tgan zamon fe'li] + [qolgan qismi].

Savolni GAPGA aylantirasiz:
  savol:  WHO directed E.T.?
  javob:  Steven Spielberg
  gap:    SPIELBERG DIRECTED E.T.

DIQQAT: savol so'zi ('Who', 'Which film') o'rniga
JAVOB qo'yiladi, fe'l shakli O'ZGARMAYDI —
chunki savolda ham 'did' yo'q edi.

items.whyUz:
'Who' o'rniga 'Spielberg' qo'yildi,
fe'l 'directed' o'zgarmadi.

items.textEn: 2  Bill Clinton / become / President of the USA in 1992
items.answer: Bill Clinton became President of the USA in 1992.
items.whyUz: 'become President' — unvon oldidan artikl YO'Q.

Film nomi EGA vazifasida.
'11 Oscars' — son bor, artikl kerak emas.

items.textEn: 4  Elton John / sing / Candle in the Wind for Princess Diana
items.answer: Elton John sang Candle in the Wind for Princess Diana.
items.whyUz:
'sing FOR somebody' = kimdir uchun kuylamoq.
'Princess Diana' — unvon + ism, artikl YO'Q.

items.textEn: 5  France / win / the World Cup in 1998
items.answer: France won the World Cup in 1998.
items.whyUz:
'France' — mamlakat nomi, artikl YO'Q.
'THE World Cup' — yagona turnir → THE.
Kitob nomi oldidan artikl YO'Q.

'THE Titanic' — kema nomi oldidan THE.
'sank' — noto'g'ri fe'lning o'tgan shakli.

groups.explanationUz: Bir bo'g'inli, urg'uli unli ikki undosh orasida.

groups.ruleUz: DIE bilan predloglar — eng muhim juftlik

patterns.formula: Ega + WAS + a famous + millat + kasb.
patterns.exampleEn: Picasso was a famous Spanish painter. Henry Moore was a famous British sculptor.
patterns.exampleUz: Pikasso mashhur ispan rassomi edi. Genri Mur mashhur britaniyalik haykaltarosh edi.

patterns.formula: WHO / WHICH + ot + O'TGAN fe'l + ...?   ('did' YO'Q)
patterns.exampleEn: Who wrote Oliver Twist? Which ship sank in 1912?
patterns.exampleUz: 'Oliver Tvist' ni kim yozgan? 1912-yilda qaysi kema cho'kdi?
patterns.explanationUz:
Savol so'zi EGA bo'lsa 'did' KERAK EMAS —
fe'l to'g'ridan-to'g'ri o'tgan shaklda.

patterns.formula: Ega + RECEIVED / WON + mukofot + IN + yil.
patterns.exampleEn: Mother Teresa received the Nobel Prize for Peace in 1979. France won the World Cup in 1998.
patterns.exampleUz: Ona Tereza 1979-yilda tinchlik bo'yicha Nobel mukofotini oldi. Fransiya 1998-yilda Jahon chempionatini yutdi.
patterns.explanationUz:
'receive a prize' va 'win a prize' — ikkalasi ham to'g'ri.
Mukofot nomlari oldidan THE.

patterns.formula: Ega + DIED IN an accident   ↔   Ega + DIED OF an illness.
patterns.exampleEn: James Dean died in a car accident. Her grandfather died of pneumonia.
patterns.exampleUz: Jeyms Din avtohalokatda halok bo'ldi. Uning bobosi pnevmoniyadan vafot etdi.

patterns.formula: Ega + TRAVELLED ROUND the world AND RETURNED TO + joy.
patterns.exampleEn: Carlo travelled round the world for a year and returned to Italy last month.
patterns.exampleUz: Karlo bir yil dunyo bo'ylab sayohat qildi va o'tgan oy Italiyaga qaytdi.

patterns.formula: Ega + HAD PROBLEMS WITH + ot AND DIVORCED IN + oy, yil.
patterns.exampleEn: Mike and Sarah had problems with their marriage and divorced in September, 1997.
patterns.exampleUz: Mayk va Sara nikohlarida muammoga duch kelishdi va 1997-yil sentabrda ajrashishdi.
patterns.explanationUz: 'problems WITH';  oy va yil bilan IN.
